svg.title: 08. Crossed leg outer hip stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Stand with your right side near a support. Hold it. Cross your left foot in front of your right foot. Move your right hip towards the support and lean your chest slightly left.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://myhealth.alberta.ca/health/AfterCareInformation/pages/conditions.aspx?hwid=bo1543
